```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

## History Data Schema

```{r}
history_data <- arrow::open_dataset("data/history.parquet")
print(history_data$schema)
```

## Main Forecasting Table

```{r}
#| cache: true
markets <- arrow::read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")

history <- arrow::open_dataset("data/history.parquet")

joined <- history |>
  left_join(
    markets |> select(market_id, outcome),
    by = "market_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = case_when(
      outcome == "YES" ~ 1,
      outcome == "NO" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  collect()

nrow(joined)
```

## Prediction Accuracy by Time Bucket

```{r}
# Create the accuracy summary
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(horizon) |>
  summarise(
    mean_error = mean(absolute_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  rename(time_bucket = horizon)

print(accuracy)

# Create the chart
ggplot(
  accuracy,
  aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_error, group = 1)
) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Days remaining",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )
```

## Final-Day Calibration

```{r}
# Select final-day predictions
final_day <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0)

# Create 10-percentage-point probability bins
calibration <- final_day |>
  mutate(
    probability_bin = floor(
      pmin(probability, 0.999999) * 10
    ) / 10
  ) |>
  group_by(probability_bin) |>
  summarise(
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(calibration)
```

## Calibration Curve

```{r}
# Keep the calibration summary
print(calibration)

# Create calibration curve
ggplot(
  calibration,
  aes(
    x = probability_bin + 0.05,
    y = actual_rate
  )
) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50"
  ) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = n),
    color = "steelblue",
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Number of markets") +
  labs(
    title = "Do prediction market probabilities match actual outcomes?",
    subtitle = "Final-day forecasts compared with actual YES resolution rates",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Actual YES resolution rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```
